T.taglineRest: — single-file, mostly offline, no account. Each app states its limits.
T.noteTxt: Personal projects by one author, not official services. Educational use only: nothing here is medical, legal or financial advice. Each app's README lists any request it makes to third parties.
T.fOffPart: Works offline, some features need internet
T.demoLead: Short silent screen recordings of each app, with subtitles in 8 languages. Hosted here, no third-party player.
T.aboutLine: Alexandru-Ionuț Chiuță (Alexio): Romanian engineer and science-fiction author. Independent personal projects — not services of any institution and not official sources. Questions, corrections or removal requests:
T.dataAsOf: Data checked by the author on {d}
T.staleTip: The last update is older than twice the source cadence ({c}).
T.fOnlyRoEn: Sheet text exists only in Romanian and English; shown in English.
T.legendLab: Lab. It works, but is not recommended for everyday use until fixed. The state is declared explicitly in the catalog, not computed from a score; a lab app never appears in “Recommended”.
T.platWebLong: runs in the browser (a single HTML file)
T.platNativeLong: installable native program, not a web page
T.evTitle: Level of evidence for what the practice claims (0–4)
T.ev2: systematic observations, small or preliminary studies
T.evMode: Historical / cultural mode: presented as tradition, not as established fact. The level rates the claims of the practice, not the software.
T.healthNote: For information only. It does not replace a doctor or another health professional; for health problems consult one, and in an emergency call 112.
T.fragileNote: Depends on third-party sites or services that can change or block access; it may stop working without notice.
T.legendCov: Coverage. The label on each card gives the interface languages (out of 8: ro, en, fr, it, es, pt, de, hu) and the platform: web (a file that runs in the browser) or installable (a native program). Score 0–4 from the number of languages.
T.legendEvid: Evidence. Cards for practices with claimed effects (astrology, energy therapies, dowsing, “therapeutic” frequencies, relaxation) show a 0–4 meter: 0 tradition / cultural value, 1 isolated reports, 2 small or preliminary studies, 3 controlled studies, 4 verified. It rates the claims of the practice, not the software; 0–1 means “historical / cultural mode”.
T.legendHealth: “Does not replace a doctor”: shown on apps with health-related content.
T.legendFragile: “Fragile”: the app depends on third-party sites or services (scraping, unofficial embeds, public APIs) and may stop working without notice.
T.legendStatus: Status. stable: version 1.0.0 or later with no experimental declaration in the README; experimental: declared so in the README; alpha: version 0.x or with an -alpha suffix. Derived by rule, not assessed one by one.
T.legendVer: Versions follow MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (SemVer), as declared by each app.
T.legendSubst: A date next to the version is the last substantive change; when absent it is not recorded (the catalog sync date is in the sheet).

rust.title: Rust: native programs, not HTML files
rust.intro: Projects written in Rust that are not single-file HTML apps: OSATURA (animation engine, alpha), VERIGA (link checker), TEZAUR (thesis research assistant, version 0.x) and LegatorOCR (scans → searchable PDF, version 0.x).

verificare.title: Verification, sources and web traces
verificare.intro: Tools for checking where a piece of information comes from, what changed since publication, and whether a link is still alive. Each one declares in its README which requests it makes to third parties.

educatie.title: Education and professional tools
educatie.intro: Learning material and working tools for amateur radio, accessibility, event organization and working with text and data. Unofficial tools: they do not replace any authority.

stiinta.title: Science, nature and fieldwork
stiinta.intro: Visualizations and encyclopedias built on public data. Where the data is approximate, the app says so.

jocuri.title: Strategy games and rule atlases
jocuri.intro: Each game has an engine separate from the interface, a heuristic AI opponent with no access to hidden information, and its own test suites (for example, Belot: over 450,000 automated checks).

ai.title: AI under the user's control
ai.intro: Interfaces that let the user decide what leaves and where it goes. API keys stay in the browser, only "obscured", not encrypted: read the README before using them.

utilitare.title: Utilities and creative projects
utilitare.intro: Small tools, built to last: one file, no account.

cultura.title: Culture, practices and beliefs: a descriptive study
cultura.intro: These apps describe practices without scientific evidence of efficacy (astrology, tarot, numerology, reiki, dowsing, etc.) as an object of cultural study, not as a recommendation. They do not replace medical, legal or financial advice.

recomandate.title: Recommended
recomandate.intro: A selection to start with: source checking, translation, learning and working tools.

confidentialitate.title: Privacy and authenticity
confidentialitate.intro: Strip file metadata, encrypt locally and check provenance credentials. Not independently audited: do not rely on them as the only safeguard for truly sensitive data.

literatura.title: Literature and language
literatura.intro: Dictionaries, alphabets and codes, proverbs and original fiction: tools for words, writing and reading. They are teaching aids, not normative references.

teren.title: Field and trails
teren.intro: GPS tracks, field journals, hiking and survival guides. Everything runs locally; nothing replaces a map, a guide or local authorities, and nothing here is a navigation or safety device.

sunet.title: Sound
sunet.intro: Measuring, generating and analysing sound, plus music and ambience generated in the browser. The sound-level meter and hearing tests are indicative, not certified or medical devices.

gospodarie.title: Home and organisation
gospodarie.intro: Calendar, budget, family tree, notes and time: tools for everyday matters, with data kept in this browser, no account. Not financial, legal or tax advice.

misc.cultureNote: Read first. Descriptive content about scientifically unvalidated practices. Not a treatment or decision recommendation.
